teacherNote: Marked against: Correct option: (A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A (1). Both the assertion and the reason are true statements, and the reason correctly explains why magnetic field lines never intersect. The correct option is (A). Remember that at any point in a magnetic field, there can only be one net direction of the field, so a compass needle cannot point in two directions simultaneously.
